findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_user_context, search_families, get_icon_by_hash · Private data: download_asset, download_multiple_assets, get_asset_files · Public sink: get_user_context, download_multiple_assets · Destructive: search_assets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_user_context, search_families, get_icon_by_hash · Private data: download_asset, download_multiple_assets, get_asset_files · Public sink: get_user_context, download_multiple_assets · Destructive: search_assets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
